title: Pipeline scheduler (rayon workers + HIP streams + async overlap)
description:
## Goal

Hybrid scheduler that pairs each rayon worker with one HIP stream
and overlaps CPU preparation of batch N+1 against GPU execution
of batch N.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor for
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Trace shows GPU stream activity overlapping CPU stage
  activity within the same SNR point (no serial-only-utilisation
  gaps); receipt logged in `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/`.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: combined CPU+GPU throughput
  receipt vs CPU-only-24-thread baseline on the calibration chain.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
